detail.longDescription:
PDF Reader is more than just a simple viewer. It’s a complete document productivity suite designed to make your workflow easier. Whether you're reviewing contracts, annotating lecture notes, scanning receipts, or generating AI summaries, the PDF Reader gives you the tools to do it all — quickly and efficiently.
🔧 Why Choose PDF Reader?
📚 Multi-Format Document Viewer
 Easily open and read PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and EPUB files — from business documents to e-books, all in one place.
✍️ Edit & Annotate
 Highlight, underline, add comments or handwritten notes. Sign documents with ease and make your PDFs fully editable.
📷 Scan to PDF
 Turn your phone into a pocket scanner. Capture receipts, forms, books, and IDs — instantly save them as clean, high-quality PDF files.
🖼️ Powerful PDF Tools
- Page to JPG: Convert selected PDF pages into high-resolution images
- Image Extraction: Extract embedded images from your documents
- More Tools: Merge, split, compress, encrypt, and more — all in one app
🤖 AI-Powered Summaries
 Let built-in AI quickly extract key insights from any document. Choose from:
- Short – One-sentence overview
- Detailed – Full content summary
- Action Points – Clear, bullet-style insights ideal for meetings or execution
📁 Efficient File Management
- Organize your documents with folders, renaming, search, and sorting tools.
- Scan or import files and store them locally — clean and organized.
- Built-in compression tools help free up space on your device.
📱 Optimized for Mobile & Tablets
 Designed for smooth performance across all devices. Open large files, switch tools, and scroll effortlessly — anytime, anywhere.
🎯 Perfect For
- Students: Take notes, scan handouts, and summarize study materials
- Professionals: View, edit, and share important business documents
- Everyone: Scan, manage, and convert files on the go
Download PDF Reader now and experience a smarter way to work with documents — right from your device.
